patronOf.en-US: The Word made flesh dwells among us
patronOf.pt-BR: O Verbo se fez carne e habitou entre nós

meta.basis: The Christmas crib set up in churches, which the Directory on Popular Piety commends for Christmastide, shown on a Sunday of the season; white for Christmas Time (GIRM 346a). Carved statues keep the card apart from the living scene of `nativity_christ` and `holy_family`.
